title: Elux Firerose 5000 Passionfruit Orange Guava 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Elux Firerose 5000 Passionfruit Orange Guava Nic Salt serves up a sun-soaked blend of exotic fruit flavours. Sweet yet tangy Passionfruit adds a lively burst of tropical sharpness, layered with the juicy warmth of ripe Orange and the lush mellow smoothness of Guava. Together, they create a colourful and complex fruit profile with plenty of character and a rounded, satisfying finish. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Passionfruit Orange Guava Nic Salt provides rich flavour, a tactile yet comfortable throat hit and discreet vapour production. Ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, this e-liquid works brilliantly in pod kits, vape pens and other low-powered devices. Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salts offer a convenient way to enjoy well-known Elux flavours, and thrilling new profiles, using refillable vape kits, delivering satisfaction, value, and performance in every 10ml bottle.
